rejected.why: Orf disease is closely related parapoxvirus infection but is classically associated with sheep/goats, while the cow-teat exposure and dairy farm context favor paravaccinia.
Erysipeloid is a bacterial zoonosis that typically presents as spreading erythematous plaques, not painless multiple nodules with central hemorrhagic crusts.
